steps.label: EVERY CV FOLD LEARNS ITS OWN STATS
steps.sub: From that fold's training rows only

eyebrow: Comparing 3 models, 5-fold stratified CV, ROC AUC
code:
for name, m in models.items():
    pipe = Pipeline([("prep", prep), ("model", m)])
    s = cross_val_score(pipe, X_tr, y_tr, cv=cv, scoring="roc_auc")
# logistic: 0.776  tree: 0.703  forest: 0.702
